description: MemoryBackend send_mdns lines 2331-2339: 'if dnt_address.is_none() { ...; continue; } let dnt_address = dnt_address.unwrap();'. The .unwrap() is provably safe but uses the anti-pattern of is_none() guard + unwrap. Idiomatic Rust: 'let Some(dnt_address) = dnt_address else { not_sent.insert(...); continue; };'. This uses let-else, which is both shorter and makes the control flow explicit.
title: dnt_address.unwrap() after is_none() check in MemoryBackend send_mdns — should use let-else
